evidence: Full CDIAL udara explicitly gives Prakrit uara belly, Gawri war and Maiyan wēr. Gawri var and Mai verī/varī belly fit these direct regional comparanda with source v/w notation, vowels and final ī retained. Marathi ūdar is a conservative learned-looking member of the same family; vowel length and its survey spelling remain intact. Regional transmission and final-vowel formation are qualified, without inventing an ancient ī-bearing subtype.
